items.t: North Vancouver real estate market stats

faq.q: Which public elementary school is inside Canyon Heights?
faq.a: Canyon Heights Elementary, 4501 Highland Boulevard, a K–7 school in the Handsworth family of schools, described by SD44 as located at the foot of Grouse Mountain; the catchment for a specific Highland Boulevard address should be confirmed with SD44.

faq.q: Is there a middle school in SD44?
faq.a: No. SD44 has elementary (K–7) and secondary (8–12) schools only, with no middle tier.
Route 246 runs via Highland, Edgemont and Capilano between downtown Vancouver and Highland/Montroyal, and route 232 runs via Highland and Edgemont between Grouse Mountain and Phibbs Exchange.

faq.q: Can a detached lot hold a suite or a coach house?
faq.a: Yes. Under District Zoning Bylaw 3210, Section 525, an R2 principal building may include a secondary suite and a coach house is a separate accessory dwelling unit; since June 2024, three units total are permitted on single-family lots within the Urban Containment Boundary, and provincial SSMUH rules also apply by lot size and bus-stop distance.

faq.q: What hazard checks apply to a Canyon Heights lot?
faq.a: District OCP Bylaw 7900, Schedule B sets Streamside Protection, Creek Hazard, Slope Hazard and Wildfire Hazard Development Permit Areas; whether a lot is in one is a District GeoWeb map check, and the District's flood construction level data is modelled to a 2100 (2080s) horizon plus 0.6 m.
